prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished original promotional illustration for Crisp Arcade, a collection of four simple geometric arcade games: line casting, grappling hooks, reflecting projectiles, and colorful rolling blocks. Landscape 4:3 composition intended 1280x960, full opaque artwork. Match the attached icon's restrained midnight background, crisp cyan, amber, lavender and hot-pink palette and clean retro geometry. Four playful miniature geometric worlds are arranged together in a single flowing composition, with luminous lines, a hook swinging from a square, angular reflection paths, small stacked colored bars and tiny arcade particles. Refined vector-like pixel-inspired art with subtle depth, clear shapes readable at thumbnail size. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, scores, HUD, fake screenshot, UI chrome or handheld frame. Keep motifs comfortably within safe margins. One complete original cover.
